name: Salnotes Zero
pros: Exceptional tuning for the price — widely considered a budget benchmark
Detachable cable at a very low price
Surprisingly good resolution and note definition
cons: Not the last word in technical performance or soundstage
Build quality is functional rather than premium
insight: The original Salnotes Zero became a phenomenon by delivering a well-tuned, balanced sound signature at a price where most IEMs were either V-shaped toys or poorly executed. Reviewers and the community quickly adopted it as one of the best true entry-level recommendations. It proved that good tuning does not require a high price and remains a common suggestion for anyone’s first ‘serious’ IEM.
